summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01, Rule 425 written communications) on November 5, 2026, acknowledging Aurora Cannabis's announced alternative transaction with Organigram Global while confirming its enhanced premium bid of October 6, 2026 to acquire all outstanding Aurora common shares remains outstanding. No price, premium or break fee is disclosed in the excerpt. Curaleaf asserts superior value, capital-markets profile, certainty, speed and synergies, and flags unanswered questions on Organigram's break fee, board composition and BAT investor rights. Watch Aurora board's recommendation, disclosure of Organigram's terms, and any topping or withdrawal dynamics.
